mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(gross_pay),0) gross_pay, IFNULL(SUM(endowment_insurance),0) endowment_insurance, IFNULL(SUM(medicare_insurance),0) medicare_insurance, IFNULL(SUM(unemployed_insurance),0) unemployed_insurance, IFNULL(SUM(housing_fund),0) housing_fund, IFNULL(SUM(other_deductions),0) other_deductions, IFNULL(SUM(with_holding_tax),0) with_holding_tax, IFNULL(SUM(sickness_insurance),0) sickness_insurance, IFNULL(SUM(net_pay),0) net_pay FROM `book_wage` where book_id = #{bookId} and year_period <= #{yearPeriod} and del_flag = '0';

SELECT id,book_id,deptment_id , (SELECT name from book_auxiliary where auxiliary_id = deptment_id) deptment_name, person_id, (SELECT name from book_auxiliary where auxiliary_id = person_id) person_name, identity_card, wage,bonus,allowance,subsidy,absent,gross_pay,endowment_insurance,medicare_insurance,unemployed_insurance, sickness_insurance,housing_fund,other_deductions,acc_income,acc_special_deduction, acc_child_edu_deduction,acc_housing_loans_deduction,acc_continuing_edu_deduction,acc_elderly_deduction, acc_total_special_deduction,acc_other_deduction,acc_tax_payable acc_taxes_paid,with_holding_tax,net_pay,create_time,update_time,year_period,del_flag FROM `book_wage` where del_flag = '0'
and id = #{id}
